_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); hotel signals

pit_profile.why: Marriott: 'Consistent with our focus on management, franchising, and licensing, we own very few of our lodging properties'; 'At year-end 2012, we had 3,801 properties (660,394 rooms) in our system'; 'Our industry is highly competitive, which may impact our ability to compete successfully with other hotel properties for customers'; 'Economic uncertainty could continue to impact our financial results and growth'; 'Conditions for our lodging business continued to improve in 2012, reflecting generally low supply growth, a favorable economic climate in many markets around the world, the impact of operating efficiencies across our company, and a year-over-year increase in the number of hotels'; and, of the spun-off timeshare business, 'We now earn license fees under these agreements that we include in franchise fees' (its own FY2012 10-K): a hotel management and franchise system whose fees follow the revenues and profits of its hotels through the economy, by its own account; no disruption theme is live for it

classification.quality_note: Marriott: 'Consistent with our focus on management, franchising, and licensing, we own very few of our lodging properties'; 'At year-end 2012, we had 3,801 properties (660,394 rooms) in our system'; 'Our industry is highly competitive, which may impact our ability to compete successfully with other hotel properties for customers'; 'Economic uncertainty could continue to impact our financial results and growth'; 'Conditions for our lodging business continued to improve in 2012, reflecting generally low supply growth, a favorable economic climate in many markets around the world, the impact of operating efficiencies across our company, and a year-over-year increase in the number of hotels'; and, of the spun-off timeshare business, 'We now earn license fees under these agreements that we include in franchise fees' (its own FY2012 10-K): a hotel management and franchise system whose fees follow the revenues and profits of its hotels through the economy, by its own account; no disruption theme is live for it. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price cheap; Ratio B 0.91x; +19% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +1.08; conservative 2yr +50%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -37.6%/yr (worst year FY03-FY12, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +22.1%/yr (Q3 fee guide + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +22.1%/yr (FY03-FY12 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +31.6%/yr (best 2-yr run FY03-FY12); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: MAR (retrospective, 2013-10-25) ◎ ACCUMULATE — Ratio B 0.91x (66.3% downside to Bear $15 / +73.1% upside to Bull $77) | Adj composite 2.98 vs market 1.90: gap +1.08 [UNDERVALUED] | +19% above the EPP floor $38 (19x FY13E $1.98) | Conservative 2-yr case: +50.4% total (+25.2%/yr) | At 22.5x FY13E the 15% hurdle price $59 sits at or below the BASE case; North American RevPAR +5.3% in Q2 2013, forward fee revenue +15.99-19.12% (Q3 2013 fee revenue guide); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
